flows.name: 包B-渲染验证-暗色主题覆盖与可读性-单列排布与阅读顺序

steps.eval: (() => { const root = document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-presentation="root"]'); if (!root) return false; return getComputedStyle(root).backgroundColor === 'rgb(20, 23, 28)'; })()

(() => { const els = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root [data-region-id]')); if (!els.length) return false; return els.some(el => getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor === 'rgb(29, 33, 39)' && getComputedStyle(el).color === 'rgb(232, 234, 237)'); })()

(() => { const all = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root [data-region-id]')).map(e => e.getAttribute('data-region-id')); const dom = []; for (const id of all) if (!dom.includes(id)) dom.push(id); const def = (session.definition?.regions || []).map(r => r.id); const common = dom.filter(id => def.includes(id)); const expected = def.filter(id => dom.includes(id)); return common.length >= 3 && JSON.stringify(common) === JSON.stringify(expected); })()

JSON.stringify({ theme: (session.resolvedTheme || {}).themeId, textColor: ((session.resolvedTheme || {}).tokens || {}).colorText, mode: document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-presentation="root"]').getAttribute('data-arrangement-mode'), gap: document.querySelector('#preview-root [data-presentation="root"]').getAttribute('data-gap'), order: Array.from(new Set(Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root [data-region-id]')).map(e => e.getAttribute('data-region-id')))) })

steps.screenshot: render2-01-暗色主题与单列排布生效

steps.eval: (() => { const els = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root [data-region-id]')); return els.every(el => el.scrollWidth <= el.clientWidth + 2); })()
(() => { const btns = Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('#preview-root button')); return btns.every(b => b.getBoundingClientRect().right <= window.innerWidth + 1); })()
